text:
maria: quick heads-up, I opened a small PR to patch SDK snippets and add a couple of smoke tests for the model catalog entry we changed earlier today. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4521
kevin: saw it, thanks. which model card is this for?
sanjeev: is this the one with the new TritonX-6B variant compatibility note?
maria: yes — TritonX-6B (quantized + KV-cache) — we need a short spot-check in the docs to call out seq len behaviour and the minimal fallback config.
elaine: can you paste the smoke test commands here so I can run locally?
maria: sure — it's tiny. run in the docs repo: 
```bash
pytest tests/smoke/test_model_catalog.py::test_tritonx_variant --maxfail=1 -q
# or quick manual: python tools/model_check.py --model tritonx-6b --seq 2048
```
kevin: note: the CLI name changed in sdk v2.1 -> sdk v3.0. devex reminded me that snippets must include the new import path.
devex: correct — update `from rw.sdk import Client` -> `from redwood import Client` in the snippet examples. I already left a comment in the PR.
sanjeev: also double-check the benchmark link in the model card. the old bench was for CPU-only; we should link the GPU profile file: https://bench.redwood.ai/tritonx-6b/gpu-profile.json
maria: good catch. I swapped that out in the draft but left the old link in a comment. will update.
elaine: running smoke tests now. giving quick local results: `FAILED` on the KV cache warmup test, stack trace shows mismatch in returned tokens when seq > 1024.
kevin: hmm, that matches what we saw in infra tests earlier. should we add an explicit compatibility note: "KV cache warmup may produce mismatched tokens at seq > 1024 on TritonX quantized builds; fallback to unquantized variant or set KV_WARMUP_STEPS=32"?
maria: proposal: short note in model card + one-line snippet showing fallback config. Something like: 
```yaml
variant: tritonx-6b-quant
fallback: tritonx-6b-fp16
env: KV_WARMUP_STEPS=32
```
sanjeev: that's fine. add an SDK example too: 
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
resp = client.generate(model='tritonx-6b-quant', prompt='hello', fallback={'model':'tritonx-6b-fp16', 'env':{'KV_WARMUP_STEPS':'32'}})
```
devex: tiny nit: use `fallback_policy` key to match runtime API, otherwise lint will fail.
maria: fixed in PR. also added an inline comment to the model card about throughput expectations at long context (seq 2k+) with a link to the perf dashboard.
kevin: can we add a short regression test that asserts generation deterministic over 2 short prompts after warmup? keeps it lightweight.
elaine: done locally, smoke test passes with the fallback config. I'll push the test results to the PR as a gist.
docs-bot: new CI check: docs-smoke-tests passed (3/3). See CI logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/4521/logs
maria: amazing, thanks! next steps: Kevin can you review the SDK snippet changes? Sanjeev double-check the bench links and wording. I'll update the model card blurb and merge after approvals.
kevin: on it — will review in the next hour. :+1:
sanjeev: I'll validate the perf link and add a tiny note about expected latency increase at seq > 2k.
maria: target to merge before EOD. if anything blocks, ping @kevin and @devex. thanks all. :rocket:
